signals.label: 대담·조형적 단품 선호(스태킹 대비)
evidence: According to the Vogue article, bold and sculptural pieces worn singularly are set to overtake the previous trends of layering necklaces and stacking rings.
‘Atmospheric’ pieces, bold in proportion, design and colour are the key for adding life to minimalist styled clothing.

signals.label: 실버 소재 채택 확대
evidence: Vogue quite rightly references the extreme rise in gold prices in its predictions for the year ahead.
Silver jewellery has been spotted on several catwalks and presents a cost-effective alternative to white gold both at the jewellers’ bench and to the end consumer.

signals.label: 믹스드 메탈·투톤 확산
evidence: As such, mixing metals and two-toned designs are predicted to be amongst the more prevalent trends for the coming year.

signals.label: 파인 주얼리 지향(데미파인 대비)
evidence: Opting for precious gemstones, and pieces with material permanence is always in vogue!

signals.label: 유색 보석·팬시 컬러 다이아 수요 지속
evidence: The continuing demand for natural, high quality coloured gemstones and fancy coloured diamonds, in opposition to colourless D-F grade lab grown diamonds will see no letting up.
Big investments from retailers and manufacturers into promoting tinted and brown diamonds at retail level – see De Beers. Desert Diamonds have indicated this sartorial push.
Of course, breathtaking canary yellow, vibrant pink, orange, blue and green diamonds will continue their reign at the very top end of the market.
Coloured gemstones of natural origin such as sapphires, rubies, spinel, emerald and opal will continue to add vibrancy to the most discerning of collections.

signals.label: 비정형 컷·조각 스톤 선호
evidence: I would expect this demand for pieces delivering ‘out of the ordinary’ stone shapes to only continue into 2026 and thereafter.

Whether it be the unique and charming qualities of old cut diamonds, fascinating historical intaglios that tell ancient tales, brand-new innovative diamond cuts or hyper-realistic hardstone carvings, jewels showcasing these exquisitely finished stones will deservedly find an increased popularity that will outlast many seasons to come.

signals.label: 세미프레셔스 기반의 프레셔스 세팅
evidence: Combining each of the predictions above, a big trend that can be expected into the coming years is the use of semi-precious stones for setting their precious counterparts in contemporary jewellery.
Jonathan Anderson teased this trend in his first runway show for Dior last year, stacking agate and turquoise bangles each set with diamond and quartz.

signals.label: 서명 실버·스칸디나비아 디자인 프리미엄
evidence: We would recommend selecting signed silver pieces, particularly from Scandinavian makers such as Georg Jensen, Lapponia, Anton Michelsen or contemporaries as these pieces retain a timeless style and a fairly consistent premium on the open market.

directions.title: Bold band with a bezel
directions.summary: The top two rising signals together. Start where an existing mould can be modified.

directions.title: Matte mixed metal
directions.summary: Differentiates on finish contrast. The extra plating step has to be absorbed inside the cap.

directions.title: Layering system
directions.summary: Built to combine rather than stand alone. Standardising the chain spec keeps SKU count down.

reportBias.perspective: 본 문서는 Doerr Dallas Valuations가 British Vogue의 2026 트렌드 예측을 인용·해석하며, ‘가치 보존/투자 관점’에서 파인 주얼리·내추럴 유색 스톤·서명 실버 등을 권장하는 입장이다. 경매 카탈로그 활용과 컬렉션 유지보수의 중요성을 강조하며, 랩그로운 D–F 무색 다이아몬드보다 유색·자연 보석을 선호하는 편향이 드러난다. 본 문서의 모든 트렌드·수요 언급은 이 출처의 주장일 뿐, 외부 검증 데이터는 제시되지 않았다.
notes: 이 문서에는 ‘후프 귀걸이’에 대한 직접 언급이 없다. 따라서 후프의 직경/두께/프로파일(튜브형, 스퀘어 등), 클로저 타입, 중량/착용감, 가격대별 구성, 지역·연령별 수요, 베스트셀러 데이터, 마진·원가 구조, 공급망·납기, 알레르기 대응 소재(티타늄 등)와 같은 카테고리 특화 정보는 판단할 수 없다. 또한 정량 시장규모·성장률, 북미 vs. 기타 지역의 차이, 2026 내 월별/시즌별 타이밍에 대한 구체 수치도 제공되지 않는다.
